unit: Algebra · Chapter 5. Systems of rational equations
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: To solve f(x) = g(x) graphically, draw y = f(x) and y = g(x); the x-coordinates of their intersections are the roots.
stages.headlineEnglish: To solve f(x) = g(x) graphically, draw y = f(x) and y = g(x); the x-coordinates of their intersections are the roots.

stages.headline: Example: 6/x = x + 1: the hyperbola y = 6/x and the line y = x + 1 meet at x = 2 and x = −3.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: 6/x = x + 1: the hyperbola y = 6/x and the line y = x + 1 meet at x = 2 and x = −3.

stages.headline: Graphs are handy for counting roots even when the roots cannot be found exactly.
stages.headlineEnglish: Graphs are handy for counting roots even when the roots cannot be found exactly.
